content.text:
This is our interpretation of your question:

Show the ownership path, effective stake and EBITDA for each entity for 2024 to 2026

content.statement:
WITH __ownership AS (
  SELECT
    entity_name AS ow_entity_name,
    fiscal_year AS ow_fiscal_year,
    consolidation_method AS ow_method,
    ownership_path AS ow_path,
    ebitda_inr AS owf_ebitda,
    ebitda_at_stake_inr AS owf_ebitda_at_stake,
    effective_pct AS owf_effective_pct
  FROM WIPRO_FINANCE_360_APP.APP_DATA.V_ONTO_OWNERSHIP_VALUE
)
SELECT
  ow_entity_name AS entity_name,
  ow_path AS ownership_path,
  MAX(owf_effective_pct) AS effective_pct,
  ow_method AS consolidation_method,
  SUM(owf_ebitda) AS ebitda_inr,
  SUM(owf_ebitda_at_stake) AS ebitda_at_stake_inr
FROM __ownership
WHERE
  ow_fiscal_year BETWEEN 2024 AND 2026
GROUP BY
  ow_entity_name,
  ow_path,
  ow_method
ORDER BY
  ebitda_inr DESC
 -- Generated by Cortex Analyst (request_id: eb84592b-0a49-4f8a-a6bf-e3d858f285d4)
;
